EdgeHound Performance Review — 2026-06-15

Portfolio is down 10.96% ($-1,096 realized) on $12,850 staked across 29 closed trades. The primary culprit is MOMENTUM, which has destroyed -$1,019 on 21 trades at a 38% win rate. Critically, MOMENTUM was correctly disabled in the last config update. The SMART_CONSENSUS engine posted a single -$385 loss on a stop-out (FURIA vs MOUZ), which also justifies its current disabled status. SHORT_FAVORITE is the only engine generating positive alpha: +$306 on 5 trades, 3 wins, with clean resolution behavior. ELITE_FOLLOW is neutral (+$3, 2 trades) — too small a sample to judge.

Key MOMENTUM pathology: the engine is systematically entering volatile low-liquidity geopolitical and sports markets (Iran deals, tennis) where price momentum is noise, not signal. Stop-losses are triggering at -20% repeatedly, confirming the entries have no edge. Brier score of 0.274 is poor (random = 0.25), indicating near-zero calibration — predicted probabilities are not meaningful.

Current config (MOMENTUM off, SMART_CONSENSUS off, kellyMult 0.10, pMin 0.62) is appropriate and should be maintained. No changes are warranted this session. The SHORT_FAVORITE signal with tight sizing and low exposure is the correct posture while evidence accumulates. VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW remain enabled but inactive — monitor for first meaningful sample.

changeReasoning: No changes warranted. Current config reflects last session's correct diagnosis. MOMENTUM and SMART_CONSENSUS remain disabled — MOMENTUM has 21 trades confirming negative edge; SMART_CONSENSUS has only 1 data point but its nature (low-liquidity esports with wide spreads) matches known pitfall.
